data.message: Knowledge uploaded successfully. Ingestion is asynchronous: this 202 means the sources were accepted and queued, not indexed. Poll GET /context/status?database=<database>&id=<source_id> until each source's indexing_status reaches a terminal state (completed or errored) before querying. See https://docs.hydradb.com/api-reference/v2/endpoint/source-status for usage details.
